shared_elements: human-form figure in strict profile with frontal-shoulder convention
wing/feather rendering (A's wings; B's stylised elements)
disc or sun motif (A's rosettes; B's sun disc)
low-relief carved figures with incised detail
justification: Both depict profile human-bodied figures with raised arms rendered in shallow relief with linear incised detail, alongside script signs and disc motifs, which is a generic level of correspondence found in many figural-plus-inscription traditions. The differences dominate: A shows a single large bird-headed winged being amid rosette-bearing plants filling the whole field with an inscription band running across it, while B is a round-topped stela with a small lunette scene of paired figures adoring a rayed disc above many closely ruled horizontal lines of writing that occupy most of the surface.
